stop_rule.rule: the new scheme closes at least half of the control column's gap to CM1 in the sea night's mixed depth and in its 0.3-6.2 km vapour drop

lid.rule: the sea night's virtual potential temperature rise from 6.2 to 8.2 km stays at least half of CM1's

evidence: Single-column calculations on PlaSim's fifteen levels driven by the CM1 boxes' own forcing (one realization each of the settled sea box and the 0 E land box on a 6 km grid); PlaSim's vertical diffusion and dry adjustment as Python copies of fluxmod.f90 and rainmod.f90, the nonlocal scheme as written in pbl_scheme.py, the mass-flux convection scheme of massflux.py. No GCM or CM1 run is made.
reading_rule: cases: each column's compared quarter (its second), by scheme: earth_local is PlaSim as it stands (160 m), lunar_local the length stretched by the gravities (966 m), earth_nonlocal and lunar_nonlocal the nonlocal scheme beneath each. measures: mixed_depth_km by pbl_mixing.rise_height from the lowest full level, q_low/q_mid at the full levels nearest 0.3 and 6.2 km (mixing ratio, g/kg), vapour_drop_g_kg their difference, lid_rise_k the virtual potential temperature at the level nearest 8.2 km less that near 6.2 km, levels_km the levels used. Profiles top first at z_full_m; fluxes at the interfaces z_half_m (top first), upward, W/m2: heat_bl and vapour_bl by vdiff (diffusion with the nonlocal fluxes), heat_dca and vapour_dca by the dry adjustment; CM1's total (resolved and parameterized) at the same heights. dca_share: steps on which the dry adjustment acted. Convection: types and convective_share by step, tops (km) of convecting steps, conv_moistening_mm_day and conv_heating_w_m2 by layer. gap_closed: 1 - |new - CM1| / |earth_local - CM1|. one_quarter: a sensitivity, each column started from the box's air at its compared quarter's own start.
